description: One canonical grade per published protocol (DELTA / CHANGED RECENTLY / UNRESOLVED / PROTECTIVE / ALIGNED / OBSERVED) and a 5-factor control-plane rosette derived deterministically from Pacta's published records (index.json, rpc-pinned.json) and controller facts. A factor the published evidence does not decide is 'n' (not determined); docs-vs-chain parity is 'u' (uncompared) for every RPC-observed protocol. States: g strong, b moderate, a weak, n not determined, u uncompared.

(raw.githubusercontent.com/aurafinance/aura-docs/main/aura/governance/multisig-composition.md); '0x3Fa73f1E5d8A792C80F426fc8F84FBF7Ce9bBCAC' (raw.githubusercontent.com/aurafinance/aura-docs/main/aura/governance/multisig-rights.md)
evidence.observed: AuraLocker 0x3Fa73f1E5d8A792C80F426fc8F84FBF7Ce9bBCAC (Ethereum, not a proxy; the multisig-rights page links it as a contract the Protocol Multisig administers): owner() = 0x5feA4413E3Cc5Cf3A29a49dB41ac0c24850417a0, a Safe: getThreshold() = 4 of getOwners() = 7; guard slot empty. Its two enabled modules (getModulesPaginated: one complete page, next = the sentinel) were vetted from verified source; each has owner() and safeWallet() = the Safe and exposes only onlyKeeper functions that make a zero-value Call to a fixed (immutable) target, without the Safe owners' signatures: GaugeVoterModule 0x2b5Ac82C5e934407514768CE3e399d9c18381621: voteGaugeWeight(address[],uint256[]) (gauge-weight votes, capped at MAX_WEIGHT() = 2500 per gauge) and setDstChainId(address[],uint16[]) (sets gauges' destination chain ids on the GaugeVoter); ExtraRewardStashModule 0x48e529218743E41F6De5B7E8D552E8173707cE81: setStashExtraReward(pid, token) for tokens the Safe authorized (updateAuthorizedTokens is onlyOwner). Keepers and authorized tokens are set by the Safe. Neither module reaches AuraLocker, the Booster's fees, the VoterProxy, shutdown or the Safe's own owner / threshold / module configuration, so that non-delegated authority needs 4 of 7 signatures; the delegated keeper actions (capped gauge votes, gauge destination chain ids, stash rewards for authorized tokens) do not.

evidence.documented: 'Before any minting action occurs, the smart contract automatically checks reserve sufficiency using the on-chain Proof of Reserve feed. If reserves fall short, the mint transaction reverts.' (docs.bedrock.technology/security/secure-mint)
evidence.observed: Bedrock VaultWithoutNative 0x047D41F2544B7F63A8e991aF2068a363d210d6Da (Ethereum): adequacyRatio() = 900, so checkReserve() evaluates existing supply * 900 / 1000 <= reserves before minting (feeders: reserve 0xc590D9fb8eE78a0909dFF341ccf717000b7b7fF2, supply 0xE542919E4b281f10b437F947c8Ba224DdfaBc716). The incoming mint amount is absent from this inequality, so ~111.1% is not a post-mint ceiling; separate per-asset caps and collateral-transfer checks in _mint() still apply, and uniBTC.mint() (0x004E9C3EF86bc1ca1f0bB5C7662861Ee93350568) performs no PoR check of its own. MANAGER_ROLE (setAdequacyRatio / setPoRFeeder) and PAUSER_ROLE are held by 0x9251fd3D79522bB2243a58FFf1dB43E25A495aaB, an account carrying 23-byte EIP-7702 delegation code. The vault and uniBTC share ProxyAdmin 0x029E4FbDAa31DE075dD74B2238222A08233978f6, owned by the 3-of-5 Safe 0xC9dA980fFABbE2bbe15d4734FDae5761B86b5Fc3, which also holds uniBTC's DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE. This record does not assert a reserve deficit.

The protocol page names no address; this record binds its statement about the governor to the one Safe all listed controllers resolve to. The docs state the governor is a 3/5 multi-signature wallet; on chain 2 signatures of 4 owners execute an upgrade or an emergency restriction, with no timelock in the path. This record does not allege any misuse of these powers.
